decisions.statement: Each name is drawn in backticks.
The names are parted by what the caller hands over.
A caller handing nothing over parts the names by a comma and a space.
The names are drawn in the order the caller handed them over.
No name at all is drawn as an empty line.
Nothing here knows whether a name is an act or a flag.

definition: names drawn each in backticks and parted, for a line a caller reads
